about.author: Author
about.licenseNote: The full license text is in the LICENSE file in the SimpLLM folder. llama.cpp and stable-diffusion.cpp are not bundled and come under their own licenses.
about.llamaOld: llama.cpp ({build}) is older than the tested version ({tested}). If something does not work, get a newer version from the official releases and replace the contents of bin\.
about.llamaUnknown: Shown once the server is connected
about.updateNote: SimpLLM does not check for updates (it does not talk to the outside). See the Releases page on GitHub for new versions.
attach.binary: Binary files cannot be attached (text, PDF and images only).
attach.pdfTooBig: PDF files can be up to {mb} MB.
attach.textTooBig: Text files can be up to {kb} KB.
attach.textTooLong: The extracted text is too long ({count} characters).
attach.tooManyImages: You can attach up to {max} images at a time.
attach.visionNotReady: Add the image after the model has finished loading.
attach.visionOff: Image input for chat is off. Turn on "Image input for chat" under "Launch settings" in Settings.
attach.visionUnsupported: This model does not support image input. For a model that does, put the matching mmproj*.gguf in the same folder as the model.
btw.interrupt: Stop the main chat and ask
btw.waiting: Answering after the main chat finishes
code.editWarning: The chat continues after this message, so the next send will take longer while the input is processed again.
composer.attachTitle: Attach a file, image or PDF
editor.alreadyOwn: These settings already belong to this folder only
editor.applyNow: Apply to the current generation parameters
editor.applyOnSwitch: Apply these values to the generation parameters when switching to this model
editor.chatLaunchNote: Launch-time settings such as the context length are shared by all models (this is how llama-server works).
editor.deleteAuto: Delete (recreated the next time the list is checked)
editor.deleteChat: Delete (recreated from the values in the file)
editor.editStepsPlaceholder: Blank to use the common step count
editor.filesNote: The main model is picked from the folder automatically. Choose which kind of file to use for the text encoder and the VAE.
editor.introAuto: These settings were created automatically with standard values for a new model (unverified). If images do not come out well, adjust them to the values recommended by the model's publisher.
editor.introBundled: These are bundled settings. Saving here keeps your changes separately (deleting them brings back the bundled settings).
editor.introModelsJson: These settings come from models.json in the model folder.
editor.introUser: These settings were changed in the settings screen.
editor.label: Display name
editor.negative: Negative prompt (things to avoid; has no effect on models that use CFG 1)
editor.paramsNote: Blank uses the sd-cli default. Size and seed are chosen in the image bar of the message box.
editor.samplingNote: Blank means not set. With the box below ticked, the values are copied to "Generation" in Settings when you switch to this model.
editor.saveOwn: Save as settings for this folder only
editor.sharedNote: These settings are used by every model of the "{family}" family. Making them folder-only leaves the bundled settings as they are (deleting the folder-only settings brings them back).
editor.translate: Translate non-English prompts into English before use (for models that only understand English)
error.apiKey: Wrong API key. Start again from start.bat.
error.contextOverflow: The input is longer than the context limit. Shorten the message or attachments, or continue in a new chat (branch).
error.launcher: Could not connect to the launcher.
error.modelStatus: Could not check the model status ({status}).
error.refreshFailed: Could not refresh the model list:
error.unloadFailed: Could not unload the chat model ({status}).
error.unloadTimeout: Unloading the chat model did not finish in time.

export.lostImages.one: {count} image was not found where it was saved, so the export leaves it out.
export.lostImages.other: {count} images were not found where they were saved, so the export leaves them out.

hint.enterSend: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
hint.imageOnly: Only image files can be used in image mode
hint.modelSamplingApplied: Applied the recommended values of {label} to the generation parameters
hint.noHistory: · this window only (history is not saved)

history.brokenChats.one: {count} chat file could not be read (the file is left unchanged).
history.brokenChats.other: {count} chat files could not be read (the files are left unchanged).

history.loadFailed: Could not load the history (what you do in this window will not be saved):
history.saveRetry: Could not save the history (retrying in {seconds} s): {message}
image.dirsNone: none (create an image folder in the model folder)
image.editPromptNoteGenerate: Used as written, in English (not translated). The seed stays the same.
image.gpu: GPU: {name} (the one with the most VRAM)
image.noControl: Not available when started with -NoBrowser (or when the control port is in use)
image.noEditModels: No model is available for editing
image.noEditModelsExcluded: (the installed models are generation-only, or uncensored ones that are not used for editing)
image.noGenerateModels: No model is available for generation (put one in the image folder of the model folder; "Model folder" in Settings lists them)
image.noSource: The source image was not saved, so this cannot be redone.
image.notReady: Could not load the saved image. Wait a moment and try again.
image.noteEdit: The prompt and images are not added to the AI's chat history. Choose the source image with +, paste or drag and drop (the prompt is used as written).
image.noteEnglishOnly: The prompt and images are not sent to the AI. This model only understands English prompts, so write in English.
image.noteNative: The prompt and images are not added to the AI's chat history. This model takes the prompt as written (it is not translated).
image.noteTranslate: The prompt and images are not added to the AI's chat history. A non-English prompt is sent to the chat model only to translate it into English.
image.placeholderEdit: Say how to change the source image (e.g. change the background to a beach at sunset)
image.progressLoadingLong: · the first time, or right after a restart, this takes a few minutes
image.translateFailed: Could not translate the prompt into English. Try writing it in English.
image.translateNotReady: The chat model that translates prompts into English is not loaded. Try again after it has loaded, or write in English.
image.truncated: The image is cut off partway.
image.unsaved: Images were set not to be saved, so this one is gone
import.none: No chats that can be imported were found.
launch.fixedNote: Items given as launch arguments (such as -Context of start.ps1) take priority and cannot be changed here.
launch.unavailable: Cannot be changed with this way of starting (started with -NoBrowser, or the control port is in use).
meta.name: English
model.calc.notNumber: The result is not a number (division by zero, for example)
model.calc.unparsed: This part could not be understood: {rest}
model.continuePrompt: Your previous answer ended partway. Do not repeat what you have already written; continue from right after the point where it was cut off.
model.defaultSystem: You are a capable assistant. Answer frankly in English.
model.tool.badArgs: Error: the JSON of the arguments could not be parsed.
model.tool.calculate: Calculates a mathematical expression exactly. Supports + - * / % ^ (power), parentheses, the functions sqrt, cbrt, abs, round, floor, ceil, sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan, log (base 10), ln, log2, exp, and the constants pi and e. Never calculate in your head; always use this for numeric calculation.
model.tool.calculateArg: The expression to calculate. Example: (12.5 * 3)^2 / sqrt(2)
model.tool.datetime: Returns the current date, day of the week and time (local time of this PC). Use it when today's date or the current time is needed.
model.tool.search: Searches the user's past chats in this browser by keyword and returns the matching passages. Use it when you need to recall something discussed before.
model.tool.searchArg: Search keywords (separated by spaces; all must match)
modelDir.failed: Could not get the current folder.
modelDir.fixed: Cannot be changed because the app was started with -Model.
modelDir.note: Applying restarts the server and reloads the model. The models folder inside the app is always searched too.
models.imageNone: none (create one folder per model in the image folder of the model folder)
msg.cutLength: Stopped partway because the maximum number of tokens was reached

msg.dropped.one: To fit the context limit, {count} old message was left out of this generation
msg.dropped.other: To fit the context limit, {count} old messages were left out of this generation

msg.fork: Branch into a new chat from here
pdf.encrypted: Encrypted PDF files cannot be read.
pdf.fontMapTooBig: This PDF cannot be read: the character map of a font is too large.
pdf.noText: No text could be extracted (the PDF may contain only images).
pdf.notPdf: This is not a PDF file.
pdf.tooManyParts: This PDF cannot be read: it has too many parts (objects or pages).
pdf.tooMuchData: This PDF cannot be read: its contents are too large once decompressed (limit: {mb} MB).
project.duplicate: A project with the same name already exists.
project.noImages: Images cannot be added to a project.
project.pressAgainRemove: Press again to remove (the chats and the folder stay)
project.tokens: {tokens} tokens{percent}. Included in every send. After changing the content, the next send takes longer while the input is processed again.
project.tokensApprox: About {tokens} tokens{percent}. Included in every send. After changing the content, the next send takes longer while the input is processed again.
settings.languageBusy: This cannot be changed while generating. Change it when generation has finished.
settings.languageLosesChats: History is not saved in this window, so changing the language deletes its chats. To change anyway, choose the same language again.
settings.languageNote: Changing this reloads the window. Your chats are saved and stay (text you are typing is lost).
status.apiKey: Wrong API key. Start again from start.bat
status.loadingLong: The first time can take a few minutes
status.unloaded: The chat model is unloaded while an image is being processed
storage.off: When started with -NoBrowser (or when the control port is in use), chats are not saved. They are gone when this window is closed.
storage.on: Chats, images, settings and projects are saved automatically in the simpllm\history folder on this PC (not encrypted). "Delete all" also deletes the saved history.

ui.settingsPanes.p1: For chat, put .gguf files in this folder (or in its chat folder). For images, create one folder per model in its image folder and put the main model, text encoder and VAE together in it. What you add appears in the list when you come back to this window.
ui.settingsPanes.p2: Changing these restarts the server and reloads the model. Blank or 0 means automatic (the llama.cpp default). If it stops working, "Reset to defaults" brings things back.
ui.settingsPanes.p3: Blank means automatic (the official recommended values for Qwen models, the llama.cpp defaults for others).
ui.settingsPanes.p4: Images being processed are kept temporarily in .run\image and deleted when done (traces may remain on a hard disk). The prompt is not embedded in the image. Generation uses an uncensored model (Chroma). Do not make sexual images of real people or minors.
